why_not_in_place: track_g_varna_polarity_table_v2_named_vritti.json is a FROZEN input hashed by the pole-DiD, pole-sanity, and embedding experiments. Editing it in place would silently invalidate those hashes and results. resonance_framing: Per operator: varṇa mapping is a RESONANCE (associative/interpretive) mapping, not exact science. These re-readings refine the resonance; they do NOT establish ontology, semantic truth, Sanskrit privilege, or language-independent validity. No GENUTILITY_*, no ONTOLOGICAL_SIGNAL.
anti_circularity: The `ha` re-reading is motivated in part by making the word 'happy' cohere. Revising a pole gloss and THEN testing on words chosen for that gloss is circular. If promoted to a live table, it MUST be frozen and pre-registered before any pole-test word/context authoring, and the source-attested vs researcher-authored split below must be preserved.

corrections.classical_associations_attested: Sarkar: Ha = acoustic root of the ethereal (ākāśa) factor, of daytime, of the sun, of svarloka, and of parā-vidyā (intuitional science). Its OPPOSITE is a SEPARATE varṇa, ṭha (night, moon, bhúvarloka, kāmamaya kośa). Ha + ao = hao = acoustic root of Shiva's táṇḍava (a COMPOUND).

prior_v2_gloss.binding: night / darkness (the contractive opposite of ha = day / sun / light)
prior_v2_gloss.liberating: svarloka, solar ascent, Shivaic dynamism, tandava force

corrections.prior_v2_fidelity_problem: v2 BINDING='night' imports the domain of the OPPOSITE varṇa ṭha into ha's own binding cell (category error), and folds the COMPOUND hao's táṇḍava into bare ha. Night is ṭha, not ha.

proposed_gloss.binding: outward / visible vision — fixation on the manifest, physically-seen, outward-facing world

corrections.proposed_reading_basis: ha's attested thread is light -> seeing. Split as outward physical visibility (bound) vs inner intuitional vision (free).
corrections.source_attested_vs_authored: ATTESTED: ha ~ light/day/sun/svarloka/parā-vidyā (associations). AUTHORED: the binding/liberating SPLIT (outward-visible vs inner-intuitional) is researcher-imposed — the source gives associations + an opposite varṇa (ṭha), NOT an intra-ha binding/liberating polarity.
corrections.note: Consonant-only convention: 'happy' -> h+p -> ha, pa (vowels dropped; 'pi' is NOT a table key).

corrections.classical_source_quote: Sarkar: Pa is the acoustic root of ghṛṇā vṛtti (the propensity of hatred/revulsion). The six ripus (enemies) are kāma, krodha, lobha, mada, moha, mātsarya; the eight pāshas (fetters) are hatred, doubt, fear, shyness, dissemblance, vanity of lineage, cultural-superiority, egotism. Pa is the acoustic root of the FETTER of hatred (stemming mainly from moha). 'When one's psychic attraction is toward the crude, the mind has a downward tendency (pat / patati) leading to downfall; when the mind moves upward it is anurakti (attraction for the Great), whose consummation is devotion (ūrdhva gam / ūrdhva gacchati).'

prior_v2_gloss.liberating: fetter of hatred; related to moha and fear

prior_lexicon_gloss.classical_side: binding (ghṛṇā/hatred is itself a fetter = pāsha)

proposed_gloss.binding: attraction toward the crude / objects — the downward-pulling pull (pat / patati -> downfall)
proposed_gloss.liberating: revulsion OF the ripus — ghṛṇā redirected against the crude/vices (vairāgya-like turning)

corrections.proposed_reading_basis: Uses the passage's attraction axis: downward attraction to the crude = binding; and reads ghṛṇā (revulsion) as spiritually redirectable — revulsion aimed at the ripus/crude = liberating.
corrections.source_attested_vs_authored: ATTESTED: pa = ghṛṇā (revulsion), classically a FETTER (binding); the downward-attraction=downfall vs upward-anurakti=devotion contrast. AUTHORED/REINTERPRETED: making revulsion the LIBERATING pole (revulsion-of-ripus) and attraction the BINDING pole PARTIALLY INVERTS the attested assignment (classically hatred/ghṛṇā = the binding fetter). Flagged as researcher reinterpretation.
corrections.caveat: Because this inverts the source-attested pole of ghṛṇā, a pole test using it is testing the REINTERPRETATION, not the attested mapping — record which reading is in force.
